bosses.name: Oggleflint
bosses.general: Trogg chief with a couple of troggs around him. A plain fight: clear his friends, then him.
bosses.tank: Pull him with his troggs and keep them all on you.
bosses.healer: Light damage, keep the tank up.
bosses.dps: Kill the troggs first if they go for the healer, then Oggleflint.

bosses.name: Taragaman the Hungerer
bosses.general: Big demon: Fire Nova burns everyone near him and Uppercut knocks the tank away.
bosses.tank: Back him into a wall so Uppercut doesn't throw you far, and get straight back in after one.
bosses.healer: Fire Nova hits all the melee: heal through it, stay at range.
bosses.dps: Casters and hunters stay out of Fire Nova range; melee keep their health up.

bosses.name: Jergosh the Invoker
bosses.general: Caster: Immolate on someone and Curse of Weakness on the tank.
bosses.tank: Pull him round a corner so he comes into melee.
bosses.healer: Heal through Immolate; mages and druids remove his curse.
bosses.dps: Interrupt his casts and burn him.

bosses.name: Bazzalan
bosses.general: Satyr rogue: Sinister Strike and poison on the tank.
bosses.healer: Cure the poison on the tank.
